provenance.validation_details: No verifiable Content Credentials (C2PA/JUMBF) manifest found in media container.

limitations: No cryptographic Content Credentials found; analysis relies on structural heuristics.
Authenticity assessments represent scientific evidentiary hypotheses, not legal certification.
CyberGuard does not perform unconstrained facial or biometric surveillance.

Heuristic checks only; no validated deepfake model. Analysis uses at most 30 seconds of audio or eight 320-pixel frames at one frame per second; sample metadata and frame timestamps describe decoded sampling output, not exact source-frame provenance or the entire original. Audio may be resampled; codec and resampling artifacts can affect spectral heuristics.
Calibrated authenticity confidence is unavailable (confidence=0); configured detector scores and thresholds are heuristic, not learned deepfake probabilities.
Risk scores reflect heuristic signals, not a calibrated probability of deepfake content. A zero score does not establish authenticity.
